text.en:
The provisions of Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred and twenty-four amending Act
Numbered Two thousand and sixty-one are hereby continued in full force and effect until the twenty-eighth
day of February, nineteen hundred and fifteen.

Section four of Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred and twenty-four is hereby amended to read
"Section 4. This Sales Agency shall be understood to be abolished on and after February twenty-eighth,
nineteen hundred and fifteen."

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 29, 1914.
